newsitem.title: ITALY: Prodi and Bertinotti discuss Italian budget.
newsitem.headline: Prodi and Bertinotti discuss Italian budget.

text.p: Prime Minister Romano Prodi and hard-left leader Fausto Bertinotti held separate talks on the 1997 budget after a meeting of centre-left government allies, the head of the Green party told reporters.
"The summit is over," Carlo Ripa di Meana said, adding that Bertinotti had remained behind to talk to Prodi alone. He gave no further details.

Bertinotti, leader of the hard left Communist Refoundation, confirmed earlier today that he opposed government proposals to cut pensions and health spending. The budget is due to be unveiled tomorrow. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
